WITH RECURSIVE permission_tree AS ( SELECT p.id, p.permission_name, p.permission_code, p.service_name, p.request_path, p.resource_type, p.parent_id, p.sort_order, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.deleted FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT p.id, p.permission_name, p.permission_code, p.service_name, p.request_path, p.resource_type, p.parent_id, p.sort_order, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.deleted FROM permission p INNER JOIN permission_tree pt ON p.parent_id = pt.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT * FROM permission_tree ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
